tool_analysis:
1. Step Analysis
The recorded steps show a complete Magento 1.9 admin flow for creating a new simple product using the Default attribute set:
- Navigate to the admin catalog product URL (which redirects to login if needed).
- Log into the Magento admin using username and password.
- Land on the Manage Products grid, close an Incoming Message popup, and click the Add Product button.
- On the New Product settings step, select Attribute Set ("Default") and Product Type ("Simple Product") and click Continue.
- On the full New Product form, fill required fields on the General tab (Name, Description, Short Description, SKU, Weight, Status, Visibility).
- Switch to Prices tab, set Price and Tax Class.
- Switch to Inventory tab, set Qty and Stock Availability.
- Click Save to create the product and return to the Manage Products grid, verifying the success notice and the newly created product row.

2. Task Definition
The tool’s purpose is to automate creation of a new simple product in Magento’s admin with configurable product properties. It should always:
- Start from the Manage Products URL (login if redirected to login page).
- Launch the add-product flow.
- Choose a specific attribute set and product type.
- Populate key product attributes (name, descriptions, SKU, weight, price, tax class, qty, status, visibility, stock availability).
- Save the product.

3. Action Plan (deterministic steps)
1) Navigate to the Manage Products grid URL.
2) If a login screen appears, fill username and password and submit the login form.
3) Once on Manage Products, close the Incoming Message popup if it exists.
4) Click the Add Product button in the page header.
5) On the New Product settings page:
   - Select the Attribute Set dropdown option.
   - Select the Product Type dropdown option.
   - Click the Continue button.
6) On the New Product (Default) full form:
   - GENERAL tab (active by default):
     - Input Name.
     - Input Description.
     - Input Short Description.
     - Input SKU.
     - Input Weight.
     - Select Status.
     - Select Visibility.
   - PRICES tab:
     - Click Prices tab.
     - Input Price.
     - Select Tax Class.
   - INVENTORY tab:
     - Click Inventory tab.
     - Input Qty.
     - Select Stock Availability.
7) Click Save to create the product.

4. Variable Identification
From the interactions, these values should become tool inputs:
- `admin_username` – login username (text input name="username").
- `admin_password` – login password (text input name="password").
- `attribute_set` – visible text for Attribute Set select (e.g., "Default").
- `product_type` – visible text for Product Type select (e.g., "Simple Product").
- `name` – Name field text.
- `description` – Description field text.
- `short_description` – Short Description field text.
- `sku` – SKU text (must be unique).
- `weight` – Weight numeric string.
- `status` – Status select visible text ("Enabled" or "Disabled").
- `visibility` – Visibility select visible text (e.g., "Catalog, Search").
- `price` – Price numeric string.
- `tax_class` – Tax Class select visible text (e.g., "Taxable Goods").
- `qty` – Qty numeric string.
- `stock_availability` – Stock Availability select visible text ("In Stock" or "Out of Stock").

Other captured UI elements like filters, pagination, mass actions on the grid are not part of the core creation task, so they are not parameterized.

5. Step Optimization
- Navigation is best done directly via the provided URL `http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product/` (then the app redirects to login or opens the grid), so a single navigation step suffices.
- Login form fields and subsequent controls have stable element hashes from the run; we use deterministic interaction steps with those hashes.
- We should not re-use the analyze/extract_content steps, as they were exploratory and not required for the core flow.
- The Manage Products grid popup close and Add Product button have stable element hashes and are deterministic.
- New Product settings page selects for attribute set and product type, and Continue, are deterministic via element hashes.
- On the full product form, key inputs and selects are referenced by their element hashes.
- Switching tabs is deterministic via their tab link element hashes (Prices, Inventory).
- No URL-parameter optimization is appropriate beyond the initial navigation, because product creation is a POSTed form with server-side validation.

Because the environment may still sometimes show the login screen, we include deterministic login steps. The agent is assumed to be allowed to log in. All other steps are deterministic, no agentic reasoning is required.

The tool therefore has one purpose: create a single simple product with specified attributes and save it.
name: magento_admin_add_simple_product
description: Initiate the Magento 1 admin add-product flow from the Manage Products grid, select product type and attribute set, fill core product fields, and save a new simple product.

steps.description: Open Magento admin Manage Products grid (or login redirect)
Enter admin username on login page
Enter admin password on login page
Submit login form to access admin panel
Close Incoming Message popup on Manage Products grid if present
Click Add Product button to initiate add-product flow
Select Attribute Set for new product
Select Product Type for new product
Click Continue to proceed to full product creation form
Fill product Name on General tab
Fill product Description on General tab
Fill product Short Description on General tab
Fill product SKU on General tab
Fill product Weight on General tab
Select product Status on General tab
Select product Visibility on General tab
Open Prices tab to set pricing
Wait for Prices tab content to load
Set product Price on Prices tab
Select Tax Class on Prices tab
Open Inventory tab to configure quantity and stock
Wait for Inventory tab content to load
Set product Qty on Inventory tab
Set Stock Availability on Inventory tab
Save the new product

input_schema.name: admin_username

input_schema.name: admin_password
input_schema.description: Magento admin password to use on the login page (input name='password').

input_schema.name: attribute_set
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Attribute Set to select on the New Product settings page (e.g., 'Default').

input_schema.name: product_type
input_schema.description: Visible text of the Product Type to select on the New Product settings page (e.g., 'Simple Product').

input_schema.name: name
input_schema.description: Product Name value for the General tab Name field.

input_schema.name: description
input_schema.description: Full Description text for the General tab Description field.

input_schema.name: short_description
input_schema.description: Short Description text for the General tab Short Description field.

input_schema.name: sku
input_schema.description: Unique SKU string for the product.

input_schema.name: status
input_schema.description: Status select value on General tab.

input_schema.name: visibility
input_schema.description: Visibility select value on General tab.

input_schema.name: price
input_schema.description: Base Price value in the Prices tab, as a numeric string in store currency (e.g., '79.99').

input_schema.name: tax_class
input_schema.description: Tax Class select value on Prices tab.

input_schema.name: qty
input_schema.description: Inventory quantity value for the Inventory tab Qty field (e.g., '25').

input_schema.description: Stock Availability select value on Inventory tab.
